platform_contract.wsl_support_claim: integration inference; upstream README declares Linux but does not explicitly certify WSL

role_boundaries.agentswitchboard: control plane: select machine, provider, workflow, policy, validators, evidence, and escalation
role_boundaries.firstmate: crew chief: decompose and supervise parallel crew work while preserving isolated repository work
role_boundaries.session_backend: terminal/session substrate only; it does not own project decomposition or AgentSwitchboard policy
role_boundaries.coding_agent: bounded worker that reasons, edits, tests, and reports inside its assigned branch or worktree

required_before_selection: live session start and detach/reattach evidence

proof_ceiling: Repository contract, deterministic routing, and read-only WSL compatibility probe only; no live First Mate task dispatch, worker runtime, PR delivery, merge, Herdr runtime, or native-Windows behavior is proven.
